items.title: Engineers Left A Lamp In A Qantas Airbus A380's Wing: Then It Flew to Texas & Back

items.title: “Potentially Catastrophic”: Major Pilots Union Issues Urgent Warning On Airbus Engine Shutdowns
items.summary: A major pilots' union has warned that a cockpit defect linked to unexpected engine shutdowns on Airbus aircraft could have potentially catastrophic consequences, urging regulators to broaden their response after the issue emerged on more than one type.
